subject: general
question:
In the given equation, the functions of [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0451b414fe52c3600b00ae78b525fb0b9a9743866b6dc55f48f0f1afde7d0fc.png] and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854885c7f682ccf49e381b2e62fd27b657e57c4ba02b3cc3585dfe88476494a6.png] remain unchanged. What comes in place of question mark (?) in the third equation?

1. A [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ac2fd6f938d9d44b5c537572b53e272fab713a3f1d7afe9771faf30f75b170.png] B = A2 ÷ B

2. A [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea202e00a4be0084ac83d51debace24fccd74b904b07db1b3b2ae1bbd0e9a487.png] B = A + B2

3. (4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a5bf977ea785b354c4417a578f7932956a1b5fd45114e428df2af08d860910e.png] 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d65ec1c871d2eca4f0795d9351ce6a2249a28bcd4593f1cfc9d12f6f6aee836.png] 2 = ?
solution:
According to the given information,

A [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ac2fd6f938d9d44b5c537572b53e272fab713a3f1d7afe9771faf30f75b170.png] B means A2 ÷ B

A [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea202e00a4be0084ac83d51debace24fccd74b904b07db1b3b2ae1bbd0e9a487.png] B means A + B2

Using the given relation,

(4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a5bf977ea785b354c4417a578f7932956a1b5fd45114e428df2af08d860910e.png] 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d65ec1c871d2eca4f0795d9351ce6a2249a28bcd4593f1cfc9d12f6f6aee836.png] 2 

→ (4² ÷ 2) + (2)²

= (16 ÷ 2) + 4

= 8 + 4 = 12

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
